title: Epic: silent observer detection for passive/unvouched nodes
description: Detect and flag nodes that participate in mesh routing but never originate application traffic, have TOFU-only identity (no CA verification), and are unvouched by any peer. These are anomalous — could be collection nodes, forgotten sensors, or malfunctioning devices. In all cases the user should know. UI label: 'Silent observer' with neutral tooltip ('Nobody knows this node and it never talks. It just listens.'). Detection heuristic per neighbor: app_packets_seen==0 AND vouch_count==0 AND (now - first_seen) > 1 hour. Three per-neighbor counters, zero protocol changes, pure local heuristic. Spec section + all three impls + tests.
